subject: Contract renewal + procurement gateway integration / upsell
messages:
From: Jill Porter <jill.porter@acme-corp.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procure@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal intake — procurement gateway integration request

Hi Marcus,

We're preparing to renew our Redwood contract (current term ends 2027-10-31) and want to include the additional 500k token/month capacity and a change to annual prepaid billing. Procurement has asked that we integrate Redwood with Acme's procurement gateway so POs and invoicing can flow into our SSO and PO system.

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports: 
- Procurement gateway/API onboarding (username/service account + API key exchange)
- SSO provisioning for procurement portal (SAML metadata)
- Sending invoices to a different legal entity for split billing (if needed)

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our procurement fields and timeline. Our target PO issue date is 2027-09-20 so we'd like to close technical onboarding by 2027-09-10.

Thanks — happy to set a 30m call if easier.

Best,
Jill Porter
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Attachments: procure_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Jill Porter <jill.porter@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake — procurement gateway integration request

Hi Jill — thanks for the details and the timeline. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Procurement gateway/API onboarding: yes — we support service-account based API keys and can generate scoped keys for PO receipt. Security will need a short handoff for IP allow-listing.
- SSO provisioning: we support SAML and OIDC for our procurement portal; we can accept SAML metadata.
- Split billing: we can accept invoices to a different legal entity but will need a signed amendment confirming billing entity and payment terms.

Next steps (proposal):
1) I'll share a draft amendment with the updated term and capacity (attached draft-amendment-ACME.docx).
2) Marissa (AM) will confirm pricing and the upsell numbers.
3) Our Security/Compliance team will share the SOC2 summary and the evidence bundle.
4) Ops (Grace, Karthik) — can you review the procurement spreadsheet and confirm whether the API onboarding timeline looks feasible?

If that works I'll set a 30m call next week with your procurement and our ops.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jill Porter <jill.porter@acme-corp.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: procure@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-09-02T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake — procurement gateway integration request

Hi Jill — nice to meet you. Marcus looped me in to confirm the renewal/pricing side. Summary:

- Renewal term: 12 months (2027-11-01 — 2028-10-31) with annual prepaid; amendment will replace current monthly terms.
- Capacity: add 500k tokens/month quota as an upsell line item (details in the attached pricing appendix).
- Billing: we can support invoices addressed to a separate legal entity; we'll need the billing contact + W-9/equivalent on file.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- 2027-09-03: Redwood provides draft amendment and SOC2 summary.
- 2027-09-06: Acme confirms billing entity + PO approver.
- 2027-09-10: Technical onboarding complete (API keys + SAML metadata exchange).
- 2027-09-20: PO issued by Acme; Redwood countersigns and processes invoice.

I've attached the pricing appendix and a draft amendment. Please flag any redlines; if you prefer we can route via DocuSign for signatures.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-amendment-ACME.docx (docx, 58KB)
From: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@helixcloud.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Jill Porter <jill.porter@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake — procurement gateway integration request

Hi all — copied from HelixCloud (marketplace/integrations) where we manage Acme's procurement connector. A couple of clarifying questions from our side before we proceed:

1) Billing amendment: will Redwood accept a one-time credit to reconcile prior monthly usage if Acme switches to annual prepaid? We need this clarified for our finance team.
2) SOC2 / security evidence: can you share the control mapping spreadsheet (not just the summary)? Our security vendor requires a short mapping to our control framework.
3) DocuSign: if we proceed with the amendment, do you prefer DocuSign or a certified PDF counter-signature?

We can stand up the connector on a staging key while documents are final — that usually helps procurement testing.

Thanks — Sarah
Sr. Integrations PM, HelixCloud (third-party connector provider)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-11T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal intake — procurement gateway integration request

Grace / Karthik — forwarding the thread. Acme wants the procurement gateway integrated and to move to annual prepaid with an upsell. Key asks: API key onboarding + SAML, control mapping for SOC2, and a billing amendment to support split invoices.

Can you confirm:
- Ops timeline to generate scoped service account and IP allow-listing?
- Any work needed from Security to produce the control mapping artifact (see Sarah's ask)?
- If split billing needs legal sign-off, please flag and I'll escalate with Revenue Ops.

I've attached the SOC2 summary we plan to share and a clean copy of the draft amendment. If we can commit to the 2027-09-10 onboarding milestone we should be able to receive PO by 2027-09-20 as requested.

Thanks — appreciate quick turn here.

— Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 220KB), draft-amendment-ACME.docx (docx, 58KB)
